stat: Sterling cost of fine-tuning OpenAI's GPT-4.1/GPT-4o and the o4-mini reinforcement fine-tuning training rate, converted from OpenAI's published USD pricing
unit: GBP per 1M training tokens (GPT-4.1/4o) / GBP per hour of training compute (o4-mini RFT)
method: Recipe A (sterling conversion of a foreign benchmark) — OpenAI's own published USD fine-tuning pricing converted at an approximate September 2026 GBP/USD market rate
workings: OpenAI's published fine-tuning price list: standard supervised fine-tuning for GPT-4.1 and GPT-4o costs $25 per 1M training tokens; the reinforcement fine-tuning route for o4-mini bills training compute at $100 per hour of wall-clock core-training-loop time. Converted at an approximate GBP/USD market rate of 1.35 for the week of 8 September 2026 (multiple financial data sources placed the pair between 1.33 and 1.36 that week; this is an approximate market rate, not a same-day Bank of England reference rate pulled directly, consistent with the conversion methodology used in stat_002). $25 / 1.35 = £18.52/1M tokens, rounded to £18.50. $100 / 1.35 = £74.07/hour, rounded to £74/hour. Note: OpenAI began winding down this fine-tuning platform to new customers from 7 May 2026, so this cost figure has a shrinking pool of UK businesses who can actually access it as new customers.
